title: ATLAS 0.5 Architecture Review & Product Decision
author: CTO / Principal AI Systems Architect
primary_problem: ATLAS 0.4.14-rc1 is secure, grounded, and resilient, but suffers from a 37.6% false abstention rate on legitimate positive questions. This is caused by multi-hop relational blind spots (depth d=1 cap), temporal policy confusion, prompt evidence starvation due to raw passage truncation (top-3 raw evidence limit), lack of real-time operational data freshness, and operator friction from headless JSON APIs.
proposed_direction: Execute ATLAS 0.5 focusing on 5 high-leverage capabilities: (1) Bounded multi-hop graph retrieval (d<=3); (2) Structured ISO-8601 temporal interval filtering; (3) Salience-budgeted context compaction (top-3 -> top 6-8 documents within same 800 tokens); (4) Append-only in-memory delta index buffer (<500ms freshness); (5) Standalone operator Web Search & Provenance UI, paired with autonomous circuit-breaker fallback to Backend A.
why: Evidence-backed failure attribution: Phase 4I proved that 58.3% of failures occur upstream from generation (Stage A candidate starvation, Stage B evidence suppression, Stage C context cutoff). Addressing retrieval and context budgeting directly eliminates these losses.
Preserves low-TCO CPU envelope: Multi-hop graph search and sentence salience compaction run in-memory on CPU in <10ms, avoiding expensive GPU clusters or model parameter expansion.
Zero regression discipline: Preserves 100% mechanical citation precision, 100% negative abstention, and zero cross-tenant leakage by testing against the immutable 120-case canonical suite.
Transforms developer/operator experience: The operator Web UI eliminates JSON parsing friction during Sev-1 incident triage.

key_risks.risk: Combinatorial candidate explosion during multi-hop graph traversal at depth d=3.
key_risks.mitigation: Apply strict path-weight decay (0.7^d), enforce per-hop top-k branching limits, and prune cross-tenant edges immediately.

key_risks.risk: Loss of sentence narrative context during salience compaction causing hallucinated citations.
key_risks.mitigation: C2 tiered citation resolver enforces strict sentence and chunk substring alignment before citation attachment.

key_risks.risk: Memory consumption growth in append-only delta index buffer.
key_risks.mitigation: Enforce strict capacity cap (max 1,000 documents) with periodic background compaction into base index generation.

what_we_will_not_build: No external distributed vector databases (Milvus, Qdrant, Pinecone) — 1,663 chunks compute cosine similarity in <2ms in-memory.
No multi-turn open-ended agentic conversational loops — introduces stateful authorization leak risks and prompt injection vectors.
No 70B parameter GPU clusters — violates low-cost single-node CPU deployment mandate.
No Kubernetes or multi-node clustering — ATLAS remains optimized for bare metal / single VM edge and enterprise deployments.

milestone_roadmap.name: Multi-Hop Relational Traversal & Structured Temporal Filtering
deliverables: Bounded BFS graph traversal up to depth d=3
ISO-8601 temporal interval parser and metadata gate

deliverables: Extractive sentence salience compaction (Top 6-8 documents in prompt)

OIDC / RS256 public key verification in JwtIdentityVerifier

deliverables: Final commissioning report and release sign-off

first_implementation_milestone.name: Multi-Hop Relational Traversal & Structured Temporal Filtering
first_implementation_milestone.scope: Implement bounded BFS (d<=3) in StructuredRetriever and ISO-8601 date interval filtering in QueryUnderstanding.

first_experiment.title: Multi-Hop Relational Graph Traversal (d <= 3)
first_experiment.hypothesis: Extending StructuredRetriever traversal from depth d=1 to bounded BFS depth d<=3 with exponential path-decay scoring (gamma = 0.7^d) will improve candidate recall R@10 by >= 25% on relational multi-entity queries without increasing non-relational query latency or leaking cross-tenant data.
first_experiment.success_threshold: Multi-hop R@10 >= 65.0%; zero cross-tenant candidates; latency increase <= 10.0ms; zero regressions on canonical 120-case baseline.

governance_rule: Treat 0.4.14-rc1 as strictly frozen. No code changes to src/novastack/ will occur until the CTO explicitly reviews this proposal and approves the start of Milestone 0.5-M1.
